apps.name: OpenCut
apps.description: Edit videos with a browser-native timeline, media tools, effects, and export controls.
apps.capabilitySummary: Requests project file access, shared-file read access, file picker access, and notifications.

apps.name: Moodboard
apps.description: Collect images on a pannable canvas and arrange visual references.
apps.capabilitySummary: Requests private project data, file picker access, notifications, and host navigation.

apps.name: Excalidraw
apps.description: Sketch diagrams, wireframes, and ideas on an infinite hand-drawn canvas.
apps.capabilitySummary: Requests file picker access and notifications.

apps.name: CAD
apps.description: Generate, inspect, and preview STEP-first CAD models with agent-assisted workflows.
apps.capabilitySummary: Uses CAD records, starts Codex agents, opens and publishes files, posts notifications, and runs a reviewed local CAD service with Python dependencies.

apps.name: Bento Slides
apps.description: Build and present slide decks with morph transitions, built-in charts, and speaker notes.
apps.capabilitySummary: Requests private project data, file picker access, and publishing decks to Files.
